environment.compilation_mode: TempleOS native JIT shell with default compiler options

input_delivery.key_events: modifier down; 40 ms; key down; 50 ms; key up; 40 ms; modifier up
input_delivery.source_validation: Each accepted pre-submit image contains the exact requested command, decoded with the pinned font.
input_delivery.retry_timing: The ASSIGN-B retry uses 80 ms key hold and 120 ms inter-key delay; other accepted commands use 50/80 ms. Earlier definition captures precede the 500 ms source-settle interval.

observation_method: Decode original pixels with the pinned font and verify exact submitted source; visually inspect representative value and instruction images. Field tokens below transcribe the decoded native fields, without computing expected arithmetic.
boundary: Successful native probes cover the recorded divisor, computation-class, nesting, destination and evaluation-order shapes. Maintained hosted regressions compare the 38 primary fields and their same-boot repeats with source execution. Arithmetic-fault phase evidence remains in integer-division.json. Machine listings stop at the first return; post-return output is excluded. This fixture does not establish general HolyC execution or independent-machine repeatability.
